title: What Is Market Cap? Why a Low Price Can Fool You (Crypto Beginner Guide)
caption: Price alone does not show how big a coin really is. Market cap is the simple way to compare. Educational only.

scenes.head: CHEAP COIN, BIG COIN?
scenes.narration: A coin costs one cent, another costs thousands. Does the cheap one have more room to grow?

scenes.head: PRICE IS NOT SIZE
scenes.narration: Price tells you the cost of one coin. It does not tell you how many coins exist, so it can mislead.

scenes.head: THE SIMPLE FORMULA
scenes.narration: Market cap equals the price of one coin times the number of coins in circulation. It shows the total value.

scenes.head: A QUICK EXAMPLE
scenes.narration: Say a coin costs ten dollars and one hundred coins exist. Its market cap is one thousand dollars.

scenes.head: WHY IT MATTERS
scenes.narration: Larger market caps often move less sharply than tiny ones. Small caps can swing wildly and can be easier to manipulate.

scenes.head: THINGS TO REMEMBER
items: Cheap price is not cheap value
scenes.narration: A low price does not mean a bargain. Always check the supply, and know that smaller coins carry more risk.
